item.content:encoded:
Story by ZBC Reporter

THE Zimbabwe National Army (ZNA) says a procession of equipment and personnel will be conducted as part of preparations for the 2026 Zimbabwe Defence Forces (ZDF) celebrations.

In a statement, Director Army Public Relations Colonel Hlengiwe Dube said the procession will take place from 9 to 11 August 2026, moving from Charles Gumbo Barracks to Rufaro Stadium.

Colonel Dube urged members of the public not to panic, but to join in celebrating with the Zimbabwe Defence Forces.

The procession will depart from Charles Gumbo Barracks and proceed along Airport Road before turning into Dieppe Avenue.

It will then move along Crisps Road and turn into Remembrance Drive, which leads to the main venue, Rufaro Stadium.

The main ZDF Day celebrations are scheduled for Tuesday at Rufaro Stadium in Harare, while provincial celebrations will be held across the country.

item.content:encoded:
Story by ZBC Reporter

CHANCELLOR of the Zimbabwe National Defence University (ZNDU), President Dr Emmerson Mnangagwa, presided over the university’s seventh graduation ceremony at Rogers Alfred Nikita Mangena Barracks in Mazowe.

A total of 216 graduates, comprising 166 men and 50 women, were capped during the ceremony.

Speaking at the graduation ceremony, ZNDU Vice Chancellor Dr Michael Tendani Moyo said the university was competing with other institutions of higher learning to attract students of the right calibre.

He said the university’s three faculties were producing graduates with the skills required across various sectors of the economy.

Meanwhile, ZBC Board member Dr Henry Mukono and Radio News English Desk producer and presenter Prudence Mutimbanyoka were among the graduands.

The ceremony is the first graduation to be held by one of Zimbabwe’s 13 state universities this year.
